model: Essentials Matter Lightstrip Smarter Kit 80 in / 2 m (NF080K03-2LS)
name: Nanoleaf Essentials Lightstrip (Matter, US)

radios.note: Thread for Matter, Bluetooth for app-only control.

matter.note: Nanoleaf says it works with Matter over Thread. CSA's Essentials Lightstrip listing (certified 2023-06-23, Thread and Bluetooth) names family SKU NF080K02-2LS, not NF080K03-2LS, so the exact SKU match is unconfirmed.

apple_home.note: Via Matter over Thread; needs a Thread border router such as a HomePod mini.

google_home.note: Via Matter over Thread; needs a Thread border router such as a Nest Hub (2nd gen).

alexa.note: Nanoleaf lists Alexa as a voice option; works via Matter over Thread with an Echo that is a Thread border router (4th gen named).

smartthings.note: Not mentioned on Nanoleaf's page for this strip.

home_assistant.note: Via the official Matter integration; Thread devices need a Thread border router.

hubRequired.note: The Nanoleaf app controls it over Bluetooth alone; smart-home ecosystems need a Matter hub that is also a Thread border router.

localControl.note: Nanoleaf's page doesn't say whether control works without internet.

lengthM.note: 2 m (80 in) kit, as named in Nanoleaf's page address; the page's spec table didn't load for checking. Nanoleaf also sells a 5 m Matter kit (NF080K03-5LS).

multiZone.note: Zones aren't described on this page, so unconfirmed.

power.note: Power supply details aren't stated on the Nanoleaf pages found.

summary: Nanoleaf Essentials Matter Lightstrip (2 m / 80 in kit) works with Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and Home Assistant over Matter on Thread, as long as you have a Thread border router. Without one, the Nanoleaf app still controls it over Bluetooth. It does 16 million colours plus tunable whites. Nanoleaf doesn't mention SmartThings.
caveats: Smart-home use needs a Thread border router such as a HomePod mini or Nest Hub (2nd gen).
Without a border router, Bluetooth in the Nanoleaf app is the only way to control it.
CSA's listing names family SKU NF080K02-2LS, not this kit's NF080K03-2LS, so the exact match is unconfirmed.
The official page used is Nanoleaf's Canada page; no US page for this SKU was found.
